newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in light trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed unchanged against its U.S. counterpart in light trade on Saturday due to an absence of market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local unit ended Saturday's abbreviated session at T$27.507, unchanged from Friday's close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$37 million.
"There was not a lot of demand for either currency, and range trading should continue in the near term," said one foreign bank dealer.
A T$27.48-52 range was seen for Monday.-Kevin Chen(5080815)
